007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.vectorindex;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.VectorIndex;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import org.slf4j.Logger;
014import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
015
016/**
017 * Sample for reading a Select AI vector-index name.
018 *
019 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, obtain a
020 * {@link VectorIndex} object for an existing vector index, call
021 * {@link VectorIndex#getIndexName()}, and print the value.</p>
022 *
023 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
024 * <ul>
025 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
026 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
027 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
028 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_NAME</li>
029 * </ul>
030 *
031 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
032 * <pre>{@code
033 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
034 * }</pre>
035 *
036 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
037 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
038 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
039 * <pre>{@code
040 * mvn clean install
041 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
042 * }</pre>
043 *
044 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
045 * <pre>{@code
046 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
047 *   -d samples/out \
048 *   samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/vectorindex/GetVectorIndexNameSample.java
049 * }</pre>
050 *
051 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
052 * <pre>{@code
053 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
054 *   com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.vectorindex.GetVectorIndexNameSample
055 * }</pre>
056 *
057 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
058 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
059 * and diagnostics.</p>
060 */
061public final class GetVectorIndexNameSample {
062    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(GetVectorIndexNameSample.class);
063
064    private GetVectorIndexNameSample() {
065    }
066
067    public static void main(String[] args) {
068        String indexName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_NAME");
069
070        try {
071            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
072            VectorIndex vectorIndex = selectAI.vectorIndex(indexName);
073
074            System.out.printf("Vector index name: %s%n", valueOrEmpty(vectorIndex.getIndexName()));
075        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
076            LOGGER.error("Failed to load Select AI vector index '{}'.", indexName, e);
077        }
078    }
079
080    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
081        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
082                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
083                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
084                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
085                .build();
086
087        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
088    }
089
090    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
091        String value = System.getenv(name);
092        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
093            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
094        }
095        return value;
096    }
097
098    private static String valueOrEmpty(String value) {
099        return value == null ? "" : value;
100    }
101}
